item.name: 2PLY TINTED 4DOOR SIAP POTONG PERODUA KANCIL CAR TINTED UV BLACK(GELAP 50%70%80%95%) TINTED KERETA
item.title: 2PLY TINTED 4DOOR SIAP POTONG PERODUA KANCIL CAR TINTED UV BLACK(GELAP 50%70%80%95%) TINTED KERETA
item.description:
Senang untuk DIY & Pemasangan!!!
✅Siap potong utk 4pintu sisi & cermin mati kecil sahaja
✅Standard size segi empat untuk cermin besar depan & belakang supaya senang adjust
✅Tinted High Quality 2PLY UV99% Tinted Tebal , Tahan Panas Tinggi

Macam mana nak place order FULLSET?
✅Contoh: Cermin besar depan nak gelap 30%, 2pintu sisi depan nak gelap 50%, 2pintu sisi belakang & 2cermin mati kecil nak gelap 80% dan Cermin besar belakang nak gelap 95%
1. Pilih gelap 30% dan C.Besar Depan, tambah dalam kart
2. Pilih gelap 50% dan 2Pintu Depan, tambah dalam kart
3. Pilih gelap 80% dan 2Pintu Belakang & 2Cermin Mati Kecil, tambah dalam kart
4. Pilih gelap 95% dan C.Besar Belakang , tambah dalam kart
5. Kalau nak Tinted Tool Kit Scraper sahaja , sila pilih Scraper ToolKit 7pcs, tambah dalam kart
6. Check out, bayar semua sekali dan kita akan ship dalam 1-2 hari bekerja

✅Features: 【HEAT INSULATION & ENERGY SAVING】 
- The mirror window film blocks out 75%of infrared rays
- The heat control window film can retain heat in winter and keep it out in summer
- Reduce expensive heating and cooling costs

✅Installation: 
1. Water spraying on the glass surface and cleaning the glass with a towel 
2. After cleaning the glass, spray a large amount of water containing detergent on glass 
3. Split film protective layer 
4. After tearing off the protective layer spray a large amount of water containing detergent on the mucus surface to keep lubrication 
5. Put the adhesive face stick to the glass of the sprayer water, adjust and fixed position 
6. Cover the scraper with a towel and scrape evenly out the water of the excess part. Remove the knife a scraper and press the edge of the knife
